t: When two people you know have fallen out
a: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
m: The believers are but brothers, so make settlement between your brothers. And fear Allāh that you may receive mercy.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
